import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
import os
import gc

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Get target column name (species)
target_col = "species"
feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in ["id", target_col]]

# Encode labels using label encoding - use unique values from train
unique_labels = sorted(train_df[target_col].dropna().unique())
label_to_idx = {label: i for i, label in enumerate(unique_labels)}
idx_to_label = {i: label for label, i in label_to_idx.items()}

# Prepare training data
X_train_full = train_df[feature_cols].values
y_train = train_df[target_col].map(label_to_idx).values

# Split for validation (hold out ~20% for proper validation)
X_train, X_val, y_train_idx, y_val_idx = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train, test_size=0.20, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Scale features
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_scaled = scaler.transform(X_val)

# Train model with early stopping to prevent overfitting
model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    min_samples_leaf=20,
    early_stopping=True,
    verbose=False,
)
model.fit(
    X_train_scaled,
    y_train_idx,
    eval_set=[(X_val_scaled, y_val_idx)],
    verbose=False,
    early_stopping_rounds=30,
)

# Validation score on held-out set (this set was NEVER used for training)
val_pred_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val_scaled)
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val_idx, val_pred_proba)
print(f"Validation LogLoss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Generate predictions for TEST SET (labeled as 'id' only, must predict ALL species)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(test_df[feature_cols].values)
test_pred_proba_raw = model.predict_proba(X_test_scaled)

# Ensure prediction probabilities sum to 1 and rescale properly
row_sums = test_pred_proba_raw.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
test_pred_proba_raw = test_pred_proba_raw / row_sums

# Adjust probabilities to avoid extreme values per official instructions
min_prob = 1e-15
max_prob = 1 - min_prob
test_pred_proba_final = np.clip(test_pred_proba_raw, min_prob, max_prob)

# Create final submission dataframe with ALL species columns in CORRECT ORDER
species_list = sorted(unique_labels)

# Verify species order matches sample_submission
sample_species_order = sorted(sample_sub.columns[1:])
if species_list != sample_species_order:
    print(
        f"WARNING: Species order mismatch! Expected {len(sample_species_order)}, got {len(species_list)}"
    )

# Build submission DataFrame directly with correct column order
submission = test_df[["id"]].copy()
submission[species_list] = test_pred_proba_final

# Save submission file to required location
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission file saved successfully!")
print(f"\nFinal Evaluation Metric (Multi-Class LogLoss on Hold-out): {val_logloss:.6f}")
